scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run types:test && node --import tsx --test packages/*/test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run types:starter && node packages/cli/bin/bopli-theme.js validate starter-theme
scripts.build:starter: npm run build && npm run types:starter && node packages/cli/bin/bopli-theme.js build starter-theme
